name: Beguiling Nature (Ophiduan)
body:
–

Benefit: Your telepathic abilities are even more entrancing than normal. You gain a +1 trait bonus to all Charisma-based checks against creatures affected by one of your >Telepathy powers.

Special: Only Ophiduans may take this racial trait.
